Run the tests with `make`:

- **`make test-fast`** runs `pytest -m "not postgres" -q`. It skips the Postgres integration tests, so it needs no database. Use it for day-to-day work.
- **`make test`** runs the full suite with `pytest -q`. This includes the integration tests marked `postgres`, which need a running Postgres instance.

A stored project note says to start the database first with `docker compose up db`. I couldn't confirm that here. The repo has no docker-compose file, so you may have to start Postgres some other way. Without a database, the Postgres tests fail with connection errors.
